The application stands disposed of.

1. By way of this petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 [corresponding to Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973], the petitioner seeks quashing of FIR No.367/2025 dated 05.08.2025, registered at Police Station Nabi Karim, District Central, New Delhi, under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 ["IPC"].
2. The petition is predicated on the fact that the petitioner and respondent No. 2 - prosecutrix have since married.
3. Issue notice.
